paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
notes: Paper reports a cavity haloscope search for axion dark matter over 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 ueV), constraining axion-photon coupling at/near DFSZ sensitivity. Coupling type (AxionPhoton) is clear. Local DM density assumed 0.45 GeV/cm^3 (from Eq. 1). However, the provided paper content is truncated before the results section (Sec. V) and contains no numerical exclusion limit values or readable exclusion-plot data, so no (mass, coupling) data points could be extracted. | Vision: Lower boundary traced from the inset 'This work' panel (Fig. 22), where g_agamma is normalized to DFSZ units (DFSZ=1 corresponds to ~1.4e-15 GeV^-1 at ~4.5 ueV). The exclusion reaches close to DFSZ (~1x) across most of the band, with gaps/peaks near 4.26-4.32 and 4.64-4.70 ueV. Frequency range 1.025-1.185 GHz = 4.24-4.91 ueV. Coupling values reconstructed from DFSZ-normalized inset assuming DFSZ band scaling. | Calibration: Spot-check calibration: verify/stage2 ratio=3.4x
